Service Disciplines

What We Deliver

Specialized engineering disciplines designed to address the full scope of civil infrastructure challenges across Alberta and British Columbia.

Earthworks
Site Grading & Earthworks
Precision grading and earthwork design optimized for constructability, cost efficiency, and regulatory compliance on industrial, commercial, and residential sites.
  • Mass grading & terrain optimization
  • Cut/fill volume calculations & balance
  • Mass haul analysis & planning
  • Construction phasing & sequencing
  • Earthwork balance analysis
  • Civil 3D surface modeling

Stormwater
Stormwater Management
Full-spectrum stormwater engineering from hydrologic modeling through SWM pond design, outlet structures, and erosion and sediment control planning.
  • SWM pond & detention facility design
  • Hydrologic & hydraulic analysis
  • Drainage system design
  • Outlet structures & spillways
  • Erosion & sediment control plans
  • IDF studies & flood routing

Why M&Z

Why Choose
M&Z Design Consulting

What sets our engineering team apart from other civil consulting firms in Alberta and British Columbia.

Practical Design Solutions
Engineering focused on constructability and efficiency. Every design is built to work on site — no over-engineering, no unnecessary complexity. Constructable designs that save time and cost during construction.
Industry Experience
Extensive experience across industrial, municipal, commercial, and infrastructure sectors. Our team has delivered 200+ projects across Alberta and BC, including industrial facilities, highway corridors, and municipal stormwater systems.
Client-Focused Approach
Responsive communication and collaborative design. We work directly with developers, contractors, and project managers to understand constraints and deliver engineering solutions that meet your project objectives and schedule.
End-to-End Support
Engineering support from initial planning through construction completion. From feasibility studies and conceptual design to IFC drawing packages, regulatory approvals, and on-site construction support — we're with you every step.
